dedupe_keys.name: poraba drugih ne elektricnih energentov po vecjih javnih odjemalcih v obcini sempeter vrtojba

description: Poraba drugih (ne-električnih) energentov po večjih javnih odjemalcih v občini ŠEMPETER-VRTOJBA is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA ŠEMPETER - VRTOJBA. Zbirka vsebuje podatke o porabi energentov z izjemno električne energije, večjih javnih odjemalcev. Struktura temelji na FIWARE strukturi, ki so ji dodani podatki za druge energente. Coverage: OBČINA ŠEMPETER - VRTOJBA. The portal shows the English title as "Consumption of other (non-electric) energy products by major public customers in the municipality of ŠEMPETER-VRTOJBA" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA ŠEMPETER - VRTOJBA. Its keywords include optimizacija objektov in naprav, energetska bilanca. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
